task_completion.description: The agent successfully launched the 'Memorize' activity.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Memorize activity interface is visible, showing the card creation or game setup screen.

task_completion.description: The game title is set to 'South American Capitals'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'South American Capitals' is typed into the activity's title field or the Journal entry name field.

task_completion.description: The agent enters the 8 specific country/capital pairs into the game editor.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the input of pairs: Argentina/Buenos Aires, Brazil/Brasilia, Chile/Santiago, Colombia/Bogota, Peru/Lima, Uruguay/Montevideo, Venezuela/Caracas, and Ecuador/Quito.
The editor list or the game board shows exactly 8 distinct pairs or 16 cards in total.

task_completion.description: The activity is saved and appears in the Sugar Journal.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Journal view shows an entry titled 'South American Capitals' with the Memorize activity icon.

integrity.description: The agent used the Memorize GUI to create the game rather than just terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Mouse cursor movements and clicks on the 'Add' buttons or text fields within the Memorize activity interface.

integrity.description: The agent manually entered the data rather than loading a pre-existing file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots showing the agent typing the names of countries and capitals into the card fields.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual Sugar environment elements.
integrity.visual_evidence: The standard Sugar OS toolbar and Memorize activity icons are present throughout the process.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The game must be titled 'South American Capitals'. It must contain exactly these 8 pairs: Argentina/Buenos Aires, Brazil/Brasilia, Chile/Santiago, Colombia/Bogota, Peru/Lima, Uruguay/Montevideo, Venezuela/Caracas, and Ecuador/Quito. The final result must be visible in the Journal.
